message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now produces `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. Before slugifying, the title is decomposed to NFD form and the combining accent marks are stripped, so "è" becomes "e" instead of being dropped. I left the vendored `vendor/slugify/index.js` alone because its header says not to edit it by hand. The same accent-dropping behaviour would affect anything else that calls `slugify` directly, such as `src/shop/product-url.js`; I didn't change that since it's outside this bug.
